messages:
hiro: Noticing intermittent SAML login failures + SCIM 403s for several tenants after upstream IdP announced a signature-algorithm change (rsa-sha256 -> rsa-sha512) and our KMS rekey that ran at 01:04 UTC. Symptoms: signature verify failures + Decrypt AccessDenied.

nina: paste from auth-bridge:
```
2026-05-10T01:05:13Z WARN saml/verify.go:88 signature verification failed: unsupported signature algorithm rsa-sha512 (expected rsa-sha256) tenant=vertex-ops req=9f8b
2026-05-10T01:05:20Z ERROR scim/provisioner.go:210 decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: user is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999988887777:key/aa11bb22 tenant=vertex-ops
```

oscar: two parallel issues. 1) our SAML verifier enforces a single accepted sig alg; 2) a key-grant prune job removed a temporary grant the provisioner used. Both converged.

hiro: quick mitigations: A) add rsa-sha512 to accepted list behind feature flag, B) recreate scoped KMS grant for svcacc:infra-scim and restart provisioner. Which is faster?

nina: B is fastest for restoring provisioning; A needs canary/regression tests for signature handling. I'll repro the signature on a test IdP and validate.

sre-oncall: I re-created a minimal grant for infra-scim-provisioner with constraint 'kms:ViaService' and limited decrypt permission. Pods restarted, decrypts returned OK. SCIM 200s resumed.

ok bot (kmsa-bot): automated note: grant-prune job removed 1 grant at 2026-05-10T01:03:58Z with tag owner=bootstrap.

oscar: for forensics: run CloudTrail query for RevokeGrant and DecryptDenied between 01:00-01:10 to list impacted tenants. Also map SAML signature failures to IdP rotation window via provider audit webhook.

hiro: running backfill now for tenant=vertex-ops: `./tools/scim-replay --tenant vertex-ops --since 2026-05-10T00:50Z`

nina: longer-term actions: 1) add support for alg negotiation in SAML verifier (accept multiple algs, prefer config), 2) add guardrail to grant-prune job to skip grants with tag `in-use=true`, 3) inventory long-lived grants and retire orphaned svcaccs (vuln triage).

oscar: also add a post-rotate audit step: verify at least one successful decrypt and one successful SAML verify per active tenant within 5m of a KMS or IdP rotation. Failure opens a P1.

sre-oncall: suppression created for pager `scim.decrypt.errors` while mitigation continues. Keep thread updated when replay finishes.

hiro: backfill finished - 47 pending ops retried, all succeeded. Filing SEC ticket with timeline and runbook updates. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
